snapshot: Stage 03 completed and accepted by Sharon on 2026-11-16: eight standalone CrewAI recipes merged in PR #53; temporary verification scripts removed at authorized design closeout #52. Stage 02 is completed, accepted by Sharon and merged through Stage Design PR #47. Local Langfuse setup/mock work (PR #36), execution context (PR #44), and native runner plus automatic CrewAI tracing (PR #50) are delivered. PR #50 merged at `b08060f0acba74f19bc8a32aedb21316eed149c1`; its reviewed candidate passed 408 tests, static/lint/format checks and installed-release verification. Sharon completed local success, branch, correlation, input/output, readable-name and controlled-failure acceptance.  Application logging is separate work owned by a different agent under `designs/refactors/logging/`, with its own design and implementation PRs. It is outside completed Stage 02 and does not block Stage 03. Earlier logging requirements and research remain historical inputs; this closeout selects no logger, store, viewer or logging architecture and does not create or edit the logging agent’s files. Logging M2 implementation PR #55 merged on 2026-11-18 after both round 02 reviewers and originating design-session final review passed. LG-10 live manual testing remains NOT RUN and must be completed before finalizing logging design PR #51, which stays draft/open.

blocks.note: Stage 02 is completed, accepted by Sharon and merged through Stage Design PR #47. Local Langfuse setup/mock work (PR #36), execution context (PR #44), and native runner plus automatic CrewAI tracing (PR #50) are delivered. PR #50 merged at `b08060f0acba74f19bc8a32aedb21316eed149c1`; its reviewed candidate passed 408 tests, static/lint/format checks and installed-release verification. Sharon completed local success, branch, correlation, input/output, readable-name and controlled-failure acceptance. Stage 03 can proceed under its own design approvals. Application logging is separate work owned by a different agent under `designs/refactors/logging/`, with its own design and implementation PRs. It is outside completed Stage 02 and does not block Stage 03. Earlier logging requirements and research remain historical inputs; this closeout selects no logger, store, viewer or logging architecture and does not create or edit the logging agent’s files.
